name: Finasteride
description: A selective type II 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor approved at 1 mg for androgenetic alopecia and at 5 mg for benign prostatic hyperplasia. It blocks conversion of testosterone to dihydrotestosterone.

systems.note: Reduction of prostatic dihydrotestosterone and prostate volume is the labelled 5 mg indication.
Blockade of testosterone to DHT conversion is the intended pharmacology.
Roughly halves serum PSA, so an unadjusted PSA reads falsely reassuring; labelled.
Depression and suicidal ideation appear in labelling; sexual adverse effects are labelled.

monitors.why: Serum PSA is roughly halved; the value must be interpreted against that, which is the labelled instruction.
The free fraction is affected differently from total PSA, so the ratio is read alongside it.
Testosterone rises modestly as conversion to DHT is blocked.
A larger fraction of testosterone is available for aromatisation.
Labelled depression and suicidal ideation signal.
